final: WITH profile_stats AS (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS mean_profile_average FROM profile_stats) SELECT p.weathprofile, p.avg_bandwidth_usage, p.telescope_count, p.avg_bandwidth_usage - overall.mean_profile_average AS difference_from_mean FROM profile_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.mean_profile_average IS NOT NULL
